hints: Substitute $(2, 6)$ into curve $y = 2x^3 - 5x^2 - 3x + c$ to find $c = 16$.
Substitute $(2, 6)$ into $y = ax + b$ to find $b = 4$.
walkthrough:
Substitute the point $(2, 6)$ into the curve equation to determine $c$:
$$6 = 2(2^3) - 5(2^2) - 3(2) + c = 16 - 20 - 6 + c = -10 + c \implies c = 16$$

Differentiate the curve equation with respect to $x$:
$$\frac{dy}{dx} = 6x^2 - 10x - 3$$

Evaluate the gradient at $x = 2$ to find the tangent slope $a$:
$$a = \left.\frac{dy}{dx}\right|_{x=2} = 6(2^2) - 10(2) - 3 = 24 - 20 - 3 = 1$$

Substitute $(2, 6)$ and $a = 1$ into the line equation $y = ax + b$ to find $b$:
$$6 = 1(2) + b \implies b = 4$$
$$a = 1, \quad b = 4, \quad c = 16$$

ai_rubric.Tangents to Curves: Differentiates to $6x^2 - 10x - 3$ (B1). Finds $a = 1$ (M1, A1). Finds $b = 4$ (B1 FT). Finds $c = 16$ (B1).
